thesis: The page is the inspection clipboard: each section is a numbered station on a coastal house cross-section, and the signature is the finding tag (Seen / Not seen / Conducive) that fills in as you scroll.

signature.name: Station Tag Rail
signature.summary: Vertical rail with six numbered station badges; each section lights its badge and reveals a finding-tag pill (outline → green fill for Not Seen, amber border for Conducive). Final section renders complete sample report sheet. Hook: data-sw-signature='station-tag'.

motion.intro: Flashlight cone radial mask sweeps L→R across hero photo ≤1.2s, then rests; skippable.
stories: draw: dotted path from station 01→06 via --sw-p clip-path wipe
fade: finding tag fills on section entry
motion.hover: Finding tag lifts 2px with subtle shadow on card hover
